stage1.impression: This is a warm, competent night render of a long timber-and-concrete bar, but it reads as CG and not as a photograph. The light that defines the frame is a hard, single-direction raking source that throws crisp, fanned stool shadows across a bright floor, which looks like a sun patch rather than a room lit by its own practicals. The EARF pair at the far end is small, dim and almost colourless behind a black glass box, and the repeated identical stools, tables and orb lamps make it read as a catalogue bar, not a specific place a magazine would publish. Score 5.0: a decent layout render that does not yet have a hero.

blocking_9: The altar pair must be the hero, read at a glance: the speaker regions [510,360,560,440] and [650,360,700,440] need lum_median >= 50, with the smoked tint and the light through the acrylic visible, not just white batts on black
No hard, sun-like raking shadow pattern on the floor: the light pools must fall off softly from the practicals, with floor [200,640,450,800] lum_median at or below 80
The zinc counter top must not be the brightest surface in the frame ([0,420,420,480] lum_median 135 now)
The frosted screens on the right wall must glow evenly as acrylic, not read as dull framed prints
Signs of life and variety: identical stools, tables and orbs in perfect rows must be broken up with turned seats, used glasses, a coat and a record out
The specific place has to read in the frame: the step up to the listening room and the altar, the record wall, the pendants. Right now it reads as a generic bar

defects.what: Hard-edged fan of stool shadows on a bright floor from one low, small source: sun-like, not night practicals
Zinc counter top is hot (median 135) and flat, brighter than anything the frame is about
Altar pair is tiny and dim (median 29) inside a black reflective box; its smoked tint does not read, only the white woofers and batts do
Frosted screen reads as a dull framed print (median 39), with no glow and no edge light
Second right-wall screen is a flat grey slab with a soft blotch, with no sense of thick frosted acrylic
The banquette is nearly crushed (median 19.5, crush 7.4 %), so the upholstery and tufting are lost
Six identical bar stools at identical angles and spacing: a repeated-model look
Identical tables, each with an identical orb lamp and glass pair in a perfect row: a repeated-model look
Ceiling grade pushed orange (r 56 vs b 14): the fir reads as stained red, not old Douglas fir
Thin vertical line through the front table's base reads as a stray glass edge or an intersection
The back-bar speaker is grey and desaturated behind the pendant, so the configuration's tint is lost

changes.problem: The hero pair on the altar is too dim and small to read; the eye goes to the counter and the floor instead.

evidence.measured: lum_median 28.9; the left speaker [510,360,560,440] median 36, the right one [650,360,700,440] median 31, against a target of >= 45

change.setting: lamps: the altar 2 x spot (power, cone)
change.to: 380 W, cone 24 deg, aimed to wash the cabinets so light passes through the acrylic

changes.expected: Both altar speakers rise to median 55-75 and their smoked tint and horn read as the brightest, clearest objects at the end of the room.

changes.problem: A small, hard source low behind camera-left throws a crisp sun-like fan of stool shadows across a bright floor.

evidence.measured: lum_median 125.8, p5 13.9: a bright patch with razor-edged shadows

change.setting: lamps: street lamps 2 x point (power, size)
change.to: 2.0 W with a 0.3 m radius (or an area source), so it only grazes the floor softly

changes.expected: The floor drops to a soft pool with blurred shadows, median 40-75, and the hard shadow fan is gone.

changes.problem: The zinc counter is the hottest surface in the frame and reads flat and showroom-bright.

change.setting: lamps: the Domes' downlights 4 x spot
change.to: 18 W, cone 16 deg, so each makes a distinct pool on the zinc

changes.expected: The counter shows separate pools under each Dome with dark between them, median 70-105.

changes.problem: The banquette and the right side are nearly crushed, so the seating and its upholstery are illegible.

change.setting: EARF's lamps: each Orb power and glow

changes.expected: Each table gets its own small warm pool that spills onto the banquette's backs, lifting it to median 26-35 with the tufting legible.

changes.problem: The frosted screens on the right read as dull framed prints rather than thick glowing acrylic.

evidence.measured: lum_median 39.2, range 41.7: no glow; the larger screen [1070,0,1200,420] has median 65 with a blotchy centre

change.setting: the room's glowing surfaces: the screens' images (plus the frosted acrylic's roughness)
change.to: 0.10, with roughness raised so the glow is even edge to edge

changes.expected: The screens glow softly and evenly, median 60-90, and become the banquette's light source.

changes.problem: Identical stools and tables in perfect rows read as repeated copies of one model in a catalogue bar, with no sign of life in the foreground.

evidence.measured: seen: six stools at the same angle, four tables each with the same orb and glass pair

change.from: all seats square to the counter and tables; the same two glasses per table
change.to: turn 3 stools 10-35 deg, pull one out; vary the table props (a half-drunk coupe, a record out of its sleeve, a menu, a matchbook, one table bare); put the coat over the nearest stool in the foreground

changes.expected: The room reads as used a moment ago, and the repetition stops reading as instancing.

changes.problem: At 28 mm from the door the altar is a few percent of the frame and the dark glass box swallows it, so the frame has no clear hero.

evidence.measured: the altar pair occupies about 4 % of the frame

change.to: [2.6, 1.6, 1.25], 35 mm, still aimed at [16.5, 3.2, 1.2], so the pair is larger and centred through the opening

changes.expected: The altar pair roughly doubles in frame height and sits near the centre, framed by the counter and the banquette.

changes.problem: The grade pushes the fir ceiling orange-red while the floor is grey, so the palette splits rather than sitting in one warm key.

change.to: white_balance_k 2750, haze 0.006 for a little atmosphere around the Domes and the altar spots

changes.expected: The ceiling becomes a browner fir (r/b ratio under 3) and a faint haze ties the light pools together.

out_of_scope.request: Give the altar speakers a stronger tint so they carry the frame's one colour
out_of_scope.why: The speakers' colour is fixed by the Smoke configuration; only the light through them may change

out_of_scope.request: Remove or open the dark glass box that encloses the listening room
out_of_scope.why: The zone, the step and the altar are fixed by the room's design; only the light and the camera can make it read

out_of_scope.request: Vary the stool and table models
out_of_scope.why: The seats and furniture are fixed by the design; only their placement and the props may vary
